blocks.text: Binary Search sorted (tarteeb wali) list mein item dhoondne ka efficient algorithm hai. Yeh search interval (jis hisse mein dhoondna hai) ko baar baar aadha karta hai aur woh aadha chhor deta hai jahan item ho hi nahi sakta, jab tak item mil na jaye ya interval khali na ho jaye.

items: Sorted list ke middle (beech wale) element se shuru karein.
Agar beech ka element hi target (jo item dhoondna hai) hai to us ki position (jagah) lauta dein.
Agar target beech wale element se chhota hai to baen (left) aadhe mein talash dohrayein.
Agar target bara hai to daen (right) aadhe mein talash dohrayein.

blocks.text: Misal: farz karein aap ke paas sorted list [1,3,5,7,9,11,13] hai aur aap number 7 dhoond rahe hain.

items: Binary Search beech ka element (7) se shuru karegi aur target foran mil jayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne woh number likha hi nahi jo dhoonda ja raha hai (“searching for the number” par jumla adhoora hai). Kyun ke target beech ka element (7) par foran mil jata hai, is liye dhoonda jane wala number 7 hai.

Complexity: Binary Search ki time complexity O(log n) hai, is liye yeh linear search se kahin tez hai, khaas taur par bare datasets mein. Figure 3.7 Binary Search ka process dikhati hai: har qadam par search interval aadha hota hai, jis se talash zyada efficient ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: BINARY SEARCH: tarteeb wali list 21, 34, 43, 57, 66, 78 paanch dafa, qadmon ke notes ke saath. 78 dhoondo, beech se baanto aur mid (43) jaancho; 78 > 43, daen aadhe mein dekho; naya mid = 66; 78 > 66, daen aadhe mein dekho; naya mid = 78, cheez mid par mil gayi (gol nishan).
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Binary search ka process (kitab ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure mein list 21, 34, 43, 57, 66, 78 mein 78 dhoonda gaya hai. Pehle mid 43: 78 > 43, to daen aadha. Naya mid 66: 78 > 66, phir daen aadha. Naya mid 78: mil gaya. Sirf teen jaanchon mein jawab mila, jabke linear search ko chhe (6) lagtin.
Yeh program Figure 3.7 wali list mein har qadam ka middle element print karta hai. target badal kar Run karein (maslan 21 ya 50); numbers list sorted (tarteeb wali) honi chahiye.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"numbers = [21, 34, 43, 57, 66, 78]": sorted (tarteeb wali) list; Binary Search sirf sorted list par kaam karti hai.
"target = 78": dhoondne wala number.
"low, high = 0, len(numbers) - 1": dhoondne ki range poori list.
"mid = (low + high) // 2": range ka beech wala (middle) index; har qadam par us ka number print hota hai.
"if numbers[mid] == target: return mid, step": mil gaya to position aur qadam lautata hai.
"elif target > numbers[mid]: low = mid + 1": target bara hai to sirf daayan (right) aadha rakho.
"else: high = mid - 1": target chhota hai to sirf baayan (left) aadha rakho.
"return -1, step": range khatam ho jaye (low > high) to number list mein nahi.
Output: "Step 1 : middle = 43", "Step 2 : middle = 66", "Step 3 : middle = 78" aur "78 found at position 5 in 3 checks".
Khud try karein: target = 50 kar ke Run karein: middles 43, 66, 57 aur phir "50 is not in the list; checks: 3". target = 21 par sirf 2 checks lagte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Binary Search sirf sorted lists par kaam karti hai. Agar aap ka data sorted nahi, to Binary Search lagane se pehle Merge Sort jaisa koi sorting algorithm istemal karein!

blocks.prompt: Search problems ki characteristics (khoobiyan) bataiye aur Linear Search aur Binary Search ki efficiency ko compare kijiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Search problem ek collection (list) aur dhoondne wala item deta hai aur poochta hai ke item hai ya nahi, aur kahan; jawab position ya 'nahi mila' hota hai. Linear Search items ek ek kar ke dekhti hai, har list par chalti hai aur worst case mein O(n) leti hai. Binary Search ko sorted list chahiye, har qadam par interval aadha karti hai aur O(log n) leti hai. 10 lakh sorted items mein Linear Search ko 10 lakh jaanchein lag sakti hain, Binary Search ko taqreeban 20. Chhoti ya be-tarteeb lists ke liye Linear Search saada hai; bari sorted lists ke liye Binary Search kahin behtar.

items: Binary Search: har qadam par sorted interval aadha; 21 ... 78 mein 78 teen qadmon mein; O(log n).
Sirf sorted list par chalti hai.
